'''Madel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked with the [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorran]] [[Balmorran resistance|Resistance]] as a spy during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3642 BBY]], during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|battle]] for the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] freedom from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], she scouted the [[Imperial Tactical Operations Center]] at [[Camp Conquest]] and was captured by Imperial forces, who tortured her for information on the Resistance. She was eventually freed by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] raided the base.

{{GameLS}}
Upon rescue, Madel told the Jedi that the Imperials were about to execute her and the Jedi were just in time. However another Jedi named [[Warren Sedoru]] sensed conflict within her and suspected she was withholding something. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], a Doctor in the Resistance and old friend of Madel was skeptical, but upon Sedoru's insistence, Madel confessed to giving information about the Resistance. [[Nikollan Kord]], a Resistance Leader, was enraged and threatened to kill her. Madel told the Jedi about that the Imperials took the prototype for the [[Cloaking device/Legends|Cloaking device]] to the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]]. Kord, however still wanted to punish Madel, but [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Finley]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Fifth Expeditionary Force]] insisted that she be spared, because her knowledge of the Imperials could be useful. The Jedi decided to have Madel escorted off [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. The Resistance was angry, but Kimble was grateful.
{{Endgame}}
